messages:
aj: Quick heads-up — starting onboarding for zeta-13b v1 (8k). Need origin HF path, S3 target, checksum verification, and a tokenizer sanity pass. Who can own the mirror?

maria: I can run the mirror job. Which HF repo + tag? and desired S3 prefix?

aj: HF repo is big-weights/zeta-13b tag v1.0. Target prefix: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/1.0/

aj: We want sha256 checksums and a manifest.json with provenance (origin, tag, mirror-run). Also perms set to redwood-inference-read-only.

tess: fyi I noticed a tokenizer quirk with an earlier zeta tokenizer — offset-by-one on some inputs when pad_token missing. I'll run a quick diff once mirror is up.

samir: Permissions note — mirror role must have s3:PutObjectAcl on that prefix. IAM role used: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/hf-mirror-runner. I can preflight the policy.

infra-bot: mirror_job_submitted zeta-13b v1 -> s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/1.0/ job_id=mirr-20260315-001

maria: starting sync now, will stream progress. Tagging manifest with provenance: origin:huggingface, repo:big-weights/zeta-13b, tag:v1.0, mirror_run:mirr-20260315-001

build-bot: checksum_check queued for mirr-20260315-001

maria: sync 35% — large shard 3/12 still in-flight. posting final checksum once complete.

tess: prepping tokenizer diff script. running:
```
python infra/tools/tokenizer_diff.py \
  --left hf://big-weights/zeta-13b/tokenizer.json \
  --right s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/1.0/tokenizer.json
```

tess: quick findings: s3 copy missing 'pad_token' entry in special_tokens_map.json, and encode('') returns an extra leading 0 compared to HF. small but relevant for alignment.

aj: good catch. For serving we should add a registry override: "tokenizer_overrides": {"pad_token": "<|pad|>"} so runtime normalizes. Add to model config in artifact registry.

samir: mirror done. checksum sha256: abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890 length:142134567 bytes. Manifest updated at s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/1.0/manifest.json with checksum field.

maria: perms set to redwood-inference-read-only. Also added metadata: mirrored_by:maria, mirror_job:mirr-20260315-001

aj: next actions — (1) Tess to run evals on canonical prompt set for generation + embeddings (watch for tokenization regressions) (2) Samir to add presign TTL guidance to runbook (3) Maria to attach model-card and update registry entry.

tess: running evals now, will post sample diffs. expect small tokenization-induced length diffs.

samir: updating runbook: presign default 1h, env-runner 24h for private review, note on ACLs. will PR.

maria: added model-card link to manifest: https://huggingface.co/big-weights/zeta-13b/tree/v1.0

aj: perfect — thanks all :thumbsup: If any of you hit blockers ping me directly.
